info.name: kOmudIDAtukramANkaH
info.value: 1.1001 wuyAcf~ ityasya ayaM qvit-pAWaBedaH sidDAntakOmudyAM pAWitaH nAsti parantu kzIrataraNgiRyAM dfSyate .

examples: 'evaM prayAcati tadA BAskare munisattamaH' (BA॰anu॰96.1). praSabdo'narTakaH.
'sa pArijAtaM yadi na pradAsyati prayAcyamAno BavatA' (hari॰2.68.39). sAnubanDaM prArTyamAna ityarTaH syAt.
'taM gatvA sahitAH sarve varaM vE samprayAcata' (BA0 vana0 100.8). yAcYAyAM sAhityaM tu 'sahitAH' ityanenEvoktam, tena nArTaH samA.
'mftyorahaM brahmacArI yadasmi niryAcan' (aTarva0 6.133.3). niryAcan niHSezeRa yAce.
'niryAcan BUtAt puruzaM yamAya eza te rudra BAgo yaM nirayAcaTAH' (tE0 saM0 3.1.9.4, 5.1.2.4). ukto'rTaH.
'rudrAdeva paSUnniryAcyAtmane karma kurute' (tE0 saM0 5.1.2.8) niryAcya yAcYA prApya.
'(AyAcamAnA) rAmasya ca BavaM nityamaBavaM rAvaRasya ca' (rA0 5.21.22).
'AyAcamAnAM duHKArtAM…daSagrIvaparABavam' (rA0 5.19.21).
'vAgyatAM devatAgAre dadarSAyAcatIM Sriyam' (rA0 2.4.30). AyAcatImAyAcantIM prArTayamAnAm. ANABimuKye syAt.
'apyasya putrAnpOtrAMSca yAcayate bfhaspatiH' (aTarva0 12.4.38).  apistiNantena na sambaDyata iti sADIyo darSanam. na hyapiyAciryAcerBinnamarTamAha. yAcayate yAcyAn karotItyarTaH.
'atiyAcYA tu jIyeta dOrmatyAvinayena vA' (kO0 a0 3.13.37). atiyAcYA'tyaDikanirveSasya mArgaRam.
'mahyametad dadasveti tadratnamudayAcata' (bf0 Slo0 saM0 5.41). udayAcata balavatprArTayata bAQamavarayata.
'SirasA tvaBiyAce'haM kuruzva karuRAM mayi' (rA0 2.106.29). yAca ityevArTaH. nArTo'BinA.
'sagaraM cAByayAcanta sarve prAYjalayaH sTitAH' (BA0 vana0 107.41). ukto'rTaH. aByaBAzanteti pAWAntaram.
'goBistu BakzitaM sasyaM yo naraH pratiyAcate' (yAjYa0 2.161 mitAkzarAyAmudDftaM nAradavacanam). yAvanme sasyaM tava goBirBakzitaM tAvanme pratidIyatAmityaBiyukta ityarTaH.
arTa upayAcYAyAm iti DAtupAWaH. anopaSabdo nAntaramarTe karoti. api vopetya yAcYopayAcYA syAt.
'BaktilakzmIsamfdDAnAM kimanyadupayAcitam. etayA vA daridrARAM kimanyadapayAcitam' (sarva0 da0 saM0 pratyaBi0). upayAcitam=yAcanam. apayAcitamanizwaprArTanam.
'tvayA purastAdupayAcito yaH so'yaM vawaH SyAma iti pratItaH' (raGu0 13.53). upayAcitaH prArTita:.
'trElokyacAriRI sA tvaM Buvi satyopayAcanA' (hari0 2.2.50). mamedamIpsitaM kuru, ahaM tvAM pUjayizyAmi taM tamupahAraM te dAsyAmItyevaMrUpA prArTanA upayAcanocyate.

'tEstErapyupayAcitErupanatastanvyA sTito'pyantike' (DvanyAloke viSneSvareRa hindIvyAKyAyAM pf0 49 samudDftamutpalapAdAcAryavacanam). ukto'rTaH. upayAcitEH svArTasidDO pratiSrutErarTErityarTaH. itTaM ca nirUpayantyupayAcitaM tajjYAH-- dIyate yattu deveByo manorAjyasya sidDaye. upayAcitakaM divyaM dohadaM tad vidurbuDAH..
'nikzepI mriyate tuByamupadAsyAmyupayAcitam' (paYcata0 1.14).
'upayAcitadAnena yato devA aBIzwadAH' (paYcata0 2.50).
'adya mayA BagavatyAH karAlAyAH prAgupayAcitaM strIratnamupahartavyam' (mAlatI0 5).
'tasyopayAcitAnyetya tatratyAH kurvate janAH. tattadvAYCitasaMsidDihetostEstErupAyanEH' (kaTA0 13.166).. tasyopayAcitAni kurvanti pratiSrutArTamarpayanti.
'grahARAM caritaM svapno nimittAnyupayAcitam. Palanti kAkatAlIyaM teByaH prAjYA na biByati' (veRI0 2.15 ityatrANgirovacanamityudAhftam)..
